name: v0.3.36 — app icon: flat-cartoon avocado
releaseNotes:
• Swapped the app icon avocado from Apple's realistic 3D style to Twemoji's flat-cartoon style — closer to the mascot look. Still sits on the same emerald-700 squircle.
• Twemoji ships as a 600x600 SVG so it renders crisp at every Android density (mdpi through xxxhdpi). No more upscaling artifacts.
